newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Court ruling no impact on current state aid rules.
newsitem.headline: Court ruling no impact on current state aid rules.

text.p: The decision by the European Court of Justice on Tuesday to annul framework rules on state aid to the car industry only affects 1995 as the existing rules were adopted according to the correct procedure, a European Commission official said.
The Court, ruling on an action brought by Spain, said the Commission was wrong to prolong 1992 rules in 1995 without previously consulting with national governments.
"The only problem concerns 1995 and is mainly a matter of procedure," the state aid official said.
The official declined to elaborate on whether individual state aid decisions taken that year were also void, adding that the ruling must be studied in detail.

The Commission in 1995 agreed to a total 46 billion pesetas in aid to Volkswagen's subsidiary Seat SA on the condition that the troubled Spanish carmaker be restructured without delay and that it froze capacity until the end of 1997.
The current framework rules to assess subsidies in the car industry were introduced in 1996 after proper consultation with member states.
